alperin.scope: For each named group G in {C2, C3, C4, C5, C6, C2xC2, S3, D8, Q8, A4, D10, D12, S4, A5} and every prime p dividing |G|, the number of conjugacy classes of Alperin p-weights equals the number of p-regular conjugacy classes.

alperin_weights.scope: l(G) = w(G) (p-regular classes = conjugacy classes of p-weights) for G in {S3, A4, S4, A5, S5, PSL(2,7), GL(2,3), A6, S6, PSL(2,8), PSL(2,11), PSL(2,13), A7, S7, M11} and every prime p dividing |G|.

dirichlet_l.scope: Critical-line certificates for χ₄ on (0, 17] with N(17) = 4; χ₃ on (0, 15] with N(15) = 2; χ₅ (Legendre symbol mod 5) on (0, 12] with N(12) = 3. Each argument count equals the number of disjoint intervals where that character's real Z-function changes sign, so every non-trivial zero in those ranges is simple and on the critical line.

dirichlet_zeros.scope: For chi_D with D in {-3, -4, 5, -7, 8, -8, -11, 12, 13, -15, 17, -19, -20, 21, -23, -24, 24}: L(s, chi_D) has no real zero in (0, 1), and every zero with |Im s| < 30 is simple and on Re s = 1/2 (certified count = certified sign changes).

erdos_straus.scope: For every integer 2 <= n <= 1,000,000, explicit positive integers x <= y <= z with 4xyz = n(xy + yz + zx).

goldbach.scope: Every even integer 4 <= n <= 4,000,000 is p + q with p, q prime.

hadamard.scope: Explicit (+1/-1) matrices with H H^T = nI for 87 of the 100 orders 4k <= 400 (the rest are engine gaps, not open cases).

hadwiger.scope: Every graph on 1..7 vertices has a proper t-colouring and a K_t minor model for t = its chromatic number.

held_karp.scope: For the shortest-path metric of every connected graph on 3..7 vertices, OPT <= (4/3) * HK with both values certified exactly.

jacobian.scope: Every plane map (f, g) with deg <= 3, zero constant terms and coefficients in {-1, 0, 1} whose Jacobian is a nonzero constant has an explicit polynomial inverse of degree <= 3.

mds_arcs.scope: For q in {2, 3, 4, 5, 7, 8, 9}: an explicit maximum arc and exhaustive exclusion of larger arcs (MDS length bound for k = 3).

one_third.scope: Every non-chain poset with 2..7 elements has an incomparable pair x, y with 1/3 <= Pr[x < y] <= 2/3 over uniformly random linear extensions.

projective_planes.scope: PG(2,q) satisfies the projective-plane axioms for every prime power q <= 27; Bruck-Ryser classification of every order n <= 200.

ramsey_witnesses.scope: Explicit colourings certify R(3,3) > 5, R(3,4) > 8, R(3,5) > 13, R(4,4) > 17, R(5,5) > 37.

reconstruction.scope: For every n with 3 <= n <= 7, the 7-vertex census is complete (Burnside-certified) and no two non-isomorphic graphs share a vertex-deleted deck.

riemann.scope: Every non-trivial zero of zeta with imaginary part in (0, 36] is simple and lies on the critical line: the argument principle gives N(36) = 5, equal to the number of disjoint intervals where the Hardy Z-function changes sign.

rota.scope: Every choice of n bases of GF(2)^2, GF(3)^2, GF(5)^2, GF(7)^2, GF(2)^3, GF(3)^3 admits a Rota grid (B_1 fixed by GL-transitivity).

sic.scope: d=2: 4 exact equiangular qubit states with overlap 1/3; d=3: every Weyl-Heisenberg fiducial with entries in {a + b*w : a, b in [-1, 1]} found and its 9 states certified with pairwise squared overlap 1/4.

sidorenko.scope: t(H,G) >= t(K2,G)^e(H) for every graph G on 1..7 vertices and H in {K_{5,5} minus C_10, C4, C6, K_{3,3}, P4}.

strassen.scope: Exact integer rank-7^k decompositions of the <2^k,2^k,2^k> matmul tensor for k in {1, 2, 3}, hence omega <= log2(7).

zeta_zeros.scope: Exactly N(T) zeros of zeta(s) with 0 < Im s < T = 1000 (counted with multiplicity, certified by the argument principle), and Z(t) has that many certified sign changes on (0, T]: all of them are simple zeros on Re s = 1/2.
